Name: Alternative Portraits for Adventurer's Guild Expanded
Author: somniumterra
Description:
I use a translator, so English may be a little weird.

Ah, this is a low-res portrait of Zinnia/Gabriel from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12102]Adventurer's Guild Expanded[/url] I drew by myself. 

Gabriel seasonal update!

I only updated the png, CP version is not updated because I don't have time to test it and worry about bugs.



Compatible with  [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12254]Seasonal Outfits for Adventurer's Guild Expanded[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48457668]lillifer[/url]
